approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS after SWHNK-C1-PROGRESS-SNAPSHOT-V51 presented this contract as the sole next gate.

decisions_requested.statement: Approve the exact target allocation of 5 Story + 4 Q&A + 2 Structure Headers + 5 Structures = 16 L02 slots.
Approve the five Story semantic domains and their validated OPI anchors without authoring new HNK story sentences yet.
Approve the four Q&A functions while keeping all answer payloads unauthored until a separate answer-pattern review.
Approve the two structure headers as course-organization labels only, not HNK grammar categories.
Approve the five scoped course frames only as abstractions over already validated L02 OPI examples; they do not establish universal HNK syntax.
Keep every existing language-authority label and risk boundary unchanged; PA remains lexical-only, PITSA remains controlled-loanword evidence, and WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN assets are not promoted.
Keep VANI and VANUVALI excluded and meaning-null throughout Story/Q&A/Structure work until separately governed.
Confirm approval authorizes only preparation of Story/Q&A/Structure pattern candidates; it does not mark any of the 16 slots AUTHORED or VALIDATED.
